verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers verifications, reports, workflows, and account grouping by reference ID, but there is no mention of automated cross-verification duplicate/repeat identity detection (e.g., same face or document surfacing under a different name being flagged). Docs on Accounts (persona-docs-40) only describe grouping data under a shared reference ID, not automatic biometric/document duplicate detection across separate identities. missing for 10: explicit duplicate-identity/face-matching detection feature, cross-account biometric comparison, and any documentation or case study showing automatic flagging of resurfacing identities under different names.
